description: RWS legger - Ligging dwarsprofiel Primaire Keringen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Het bestand bevat gedigitaliseerde gegevens van de leggers primaire keringen die in 2009 of eerder door de diverse regionale diensten van Rijkswaterstaat zijn vastgesteld. Het bestand bevat kunstwerken, dijken en dammen die een primaire kerende functie hebben en in beheer zijn van het Rijk. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are kunstwerken, oppervlaktewaterlichamen, waterstaatswerken, waterwet. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GPKG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
